During the [[Great Galactic War]], around [[3664 BBY]], a force of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] allied with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] '''attacked''' an [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]], the warriors engaged the envoy and its defenders, but were confronted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aurei Eadon]]. Eadon succeeded in [[Death/Legends|killing]] [[Shae Vizla's brother|Vizla's brother]]&mdash;an act that earned him and the entirety of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] the Mandalorian's ire. Although Shae later challenged Master Eadon to a duel to avenge her fallen brother, the Jedi refused.
